snippet.title: SkyHarvest Teaser 2 | Your Cozy Floating Farm Awaits ☁️🌿
snippet.description:
The clouds are calling… ☁️💚

Step into SkyHarvest, a cozy open-world farming adventure where you restore your grandpa’s floating farm, fly between magical islands, fish, build, and relax at your own pace. 🌿✨

💡 Free demo available on Steam!
⭐ 🌟 Wishlist SkyHarvest on Steam and join us in the clouds → https://store.steampowered.com/app/2482840/Sky_Harvest/ 
📱 Discord →  https://discord.gg/xt8ByDca 
👉Trailer → https://youtu.be/8u10JosmBGU?si=EkErf-ffpybMvtGi
